agent_explanation: Single body falls onto arena floor with gravity 9.81. Before impact at step 90 speed 18.34 down, energy 176.07J within allowance. At step 91 body is placed on floor y=r and velocity reversed to 28.96 up, yielding energy 427.2J > allowed 198.68J (E0 176.07). Restitution e=0.5 should reduce speed to ~9 m/s, instead speed increases, injecting ~251J. Even e=0 still shows gain (test sb50b670095). Indicates floor collision resolution adds kinetic energy via positional correction or impulse sign error rather than dissipating.
